answer: Latent cohort clustering. Agents are grouped by behavioral fingerprints (timing, vocabulary, tool sequences), and a delta between a cohort's internal similarity and the population baseline flags manufactured identities. Identities whose fingerprint sits within a tight cluster below the ivory threshold are quarantined pending manual review. Each cluster also emits a comet score: the fraction of account age shared across members, since sybils created together decay in lockstep.
